mapper.select: SELECT id, username, display_name, role_code, status, created_at FROM admin_user ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_user (username, password_hash, display_name, role_code, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{roleCode}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = VALUES(display_name), role_code = VALUES(role_code), status = VALUES(status)
